# Amara

Amara is an online platform that enables users to create, edit, and manage subtitles and captions for videos, facilitating accessibility and multilingual content.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/amara/.

## Actions

- **Add Subtitle Note**: Add a note to a subtitle set.
- **Create Subtitle Language**: Create a new subtitle language for a video.
- **Fetch Subtitles Data** (read-only): Fetch subtitle data for a video in a specific language.
- **Get Subtitle Language Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a single subtitle language.
- **Get Team Details** (read-only): Get details on a specific team by slug.
- **Get User Data** (read-only): Get user data by username or id.
- **Get Video URL Details** (read-only): Get details for a specific video url.
- **List Available Languages** (read-only): Get a list of all supported languages.
- **List Subtitle Languages** (read-only): List all subtitle languages for a video.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List all teams.
- **List Videos** (read-only): List all videos.
- **Make Video URL Primary**: Set a video url as the primary url.
- **View Video Details** (read-only): View details of a specific video by id.
- **List Video URLs**: List all urls associated with a video.
- **Update Subtitle Language**: Update a subtitle language for a video.
